text: Ben maɓɓe maakani ɓe: Ko onon yo ɓiɗɓe am, yehee tefoyon fii Yuusufa e miñan-mun. Wata on taƴo e ko Alla yurmetee kon jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Ko fii, taƴotaako e yurmeende Alla nden si wanaa yimɓe heefereeɓe ɓen; tawde ko ɓe majjaaɓe kattal Alla mawngal ngal, e ɓural Makko suuɗiingal e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.
